newsitem.title: UK: NYMEX, Hong Kong Exchange signs linkage contract.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX, Hong Kong Exchange signs linkage contract.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX), the world's largest energy futures market, and the Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) on Thursday signed a "linkage contract" enabling HKFE members to trade on the NYMEX ACCESS electronic trading system.
In a statement, the HKFE said the link "will increase liquidity and price transparency in both energy and metals groups."
It said that subject to regulatory approvals in the United States and Hong Kong trading is expected to start in the first quarter of 1997.

According to the agreement, all products traded on NYMEX ACCESS will be available for trading in Hong Kong. Initial marketing focus will be on gold, copper, and crude oil contracts, the exchanges said.
